about: Generator know-how learned by the generate -> render -> independent critic -> fix loop (user 2026-10-16). A rule is general (it must hold on new seeds), with its evidence and where it lives. status: proposed -> validated (score up on fresh layouts) | rejected. Rules with applied_to=prompt are injected into the planner prompt for their room types (client.learned_rules).

rules.rule: The service zone is one composite (back-bar shelf against the wall, counter 0.95 m in front, espresso + 4-6 bar cues on it), never separate counter/shelf items.
rules.evidence: 2026-10-16 cafes v5-v8: counters dropped in 3/5 cafes when planned separately; v8 all 6 cafes have a readable bar.

rules.rule: About one seat per 1.6 m2; after planning, every empty region >= 3 m2 gets a table group (2 or 4 seats).
rules.evidence: v6 -> v8: industrial cafe 18 -> 28 pieces, 'empty centre' complaint gone.

rules.rule: Items of a row are 7 cm apart: placement keeps 5 cm between footprints, so a 3 cm row gap drops every second item.
rules.evidence: warehouse 7 racks dropped, grocery aisles, window-bar stools; fixed 2026-10-16.

rules.rule: Copies of one planned item share one model (chairs around a table, racks in a row).
rules.evidence: mixed chairs read as a home/cafe; user feedback 2026-10-16.

rules.rule: Task/conference chairs: footprint <= 0.72 x 0.75 m, no recliner/massage/gaming/lounge/executive models.
rules.evidence: a 1.1 m executive recliner blocked every pod seat and made the meeting room a lounge (officeA v3).

rules.rule: Every door gets a casing (frame); offices use lite/glass doors only; doors to the exterior are closed.
rules.evidence: user 2026-10-16; casing factory crashed on Blender 4.x until the bevel_weight attribute fix.

rules.rule: A sales floor is double gondolas in aisles through the middle (filled until no empty region >= 3 m2), neat one-product facings, checkout + register by the door; no racks or box piles.
rules.evidence: v1/v2 read as a stockroom (racks along walls, random mixes).

rules.rule: Open office: reserve a 1.5 m main aisle from the door, then fill empty floor with aligned 4/6/8-desk pods (no random yaw).
rules.evidence: officeA v3 'desks dropped in a big room'; round 1 of the office loop tests it.

rules.rule: Office floors ~60% carpet tile / 25% concrete / 15% wood; walls off-white/light grey paint + charcoal accent; never wallpaper.
rules.evidence: wood floors + wallpaper read as a house (user 2026-10-16); officeA v2 reads commercial.

rules.rule: Venue scenes (VENUE set) run Infinigen with floating objects off: the plan places everything. Floating objects are residential decoys (balloon, blanket, sofa, desk lamp, staircase).
rules.evidence: 2026-10-16 office loop r1 critic (sheet loop_office_r1.jpg): open 5-8, meeting 4-6, private 4-6, pantry 3-5; ITERATE; the pantry held 14 floating residential objects, read as a home living room

rules.rule: Office room types never see sofa, armchair, coffee/side table, floor lamp, sideboard/dresser, rug, blanket, cushion, books, vase or storage boxes in their vocabulary. Paper stacks are A4 paper, not book stacks.
rules.evidence: 2026-10-16 office loop r1 critic (sheet loop_office_r1.jpg): open 5-8, meeting 4-6, private 4-6, pantry 3-5; ITERATE; the LLM picked sofa/sideboard/floor lamp for a break room because the catalog offered them | 2026-10-16 office loop r3 (loop_office_r3.jpg): open 6-7, meeting 7-8, private 3-8, pantry 5-8: private office regressed to 3 (dining/velvet guest chairs, ladder shelf, nightstand via ABO pools); the vocabulary alone is not enough, pools need name filters

rules.rule: A repeated seat set (around a table, along a pod) uses a pitch of at least chair width + ROW_GAP. Seats that face a wall keep >= 1.0 m clearance. Otherwise every second chair collides and is silently dropped.
rules.evidence: 2026-10-16 office loop r1 critic (sheet loop_office_r1.jpg): open 5-8, meeting 4-6, private 4-6, pantry 3-5; ITERATE; 0.6 m pitch with 0.6 m chairs gave a meeting table 2 chairs; pods against walls lost the wall-side seats | validated 2026-10-16 office loop r3 (loop_office_r3.jpg): open 6-7, meeting 7-8, private 3-8, pantry 5-8: meeting table now has matching chairs along both sides

rules.rule: A centred table lies along the room's long axis.
rules.evidence: 2026-10-16 office loop r1 critic (sheet loop_office_r1.jpg): open 5-8, meeting 4-6, private 4-6, pantry 3-5; ITERATE; a conference table set across the room read as a dining set | validated 2026-10-16 office loop r3 (loop_office_r3.jpg): open 6-7, meeting 7-8, private 3-8, pantry 5-8: conference table on the room axis

rules.rule: A composite that has a worktop under upper cabinets places its appliances at known worktop slots. The generic top-surface finder sees only the cabinet top.
rules.evidence: 2026-10-16 office loop r1 critic (sheet loop_office_r1.jpg): open 5-8, meeting 4-6, private 4-6, pantry 3-5; ITERATE; microwave and espresso both logged 'no fit' on the pantry run | validated 2026-10-16 office loop r3 (loop_office_r3.jpg): open 6-7, meeting 7-8, private 3-8, pantry 5-8: pantry C4 4->6; appliances on the worktop

rules.rule: Every room of an office shares one commercial kit: a grid ceiling with a T-bar darker than the tiles and 1200x300 troffers, carpet tile or concrete (never wood planks), and commercial doors (DOOR_STYLE=office). A venue reference spec that names a floor (e.g. office_highrise: wood) overrides the default.
rules.evidence: 2026-10-16 office loop r1 critic (sheet loop_office_r1.jpg): open 5-8, meeting 4-6, private 4-6, pantry 3-5; ITERATE; the grid was present in all rooms but invisible at eye level; wood floors and panel doors read residential | validated 2026-10-16 office loop r3 (loop_office_r3.jpg): open 6-7, meeting 7-8, private 3-8, pantry 5-8: C5 ceiling 7-8 in all rooms (r2: 3-8)

rules.rule: Remove a category from the vocabulary, then also remove it from the prompt prose and drop it in the realizer. The planner keeps naming categories that the prompt text mentions (sideboard, sofa corner) even after the vocabulary lists them for no room.
rules.evidence: 2026-10-16 office loop r2: meeting-room still planned a sideboard after the catalog change; the SYSTEM_WORK prose asked for one

rules.rule: A free-standing table whose planned relation fits nowhere falls back to the room centre before it is dropped. A room's main table is never optional.
rules.evidence: 2026-10-16 office loop r2: the break table in_front_of the pantry run failed twice, leaving a pantry with no table

rules.rule: Every wall-length composite (counter, back bar, pantry run) can shrink to fit. A fixed 3.6 m pantry run never fits a 3.3 m wall.
rules.evidence: 2026-10-16 office loop r2: the pantry_run was not placed in a 3.3 x 4.8 m break room | validated 2026-10-16 office loop r3 (loop_office_r3.jpg): open 6-7, meeting 7-8, private 3-8, pantry 5-8: pantry run placed in a 3.3 m wall room

rules.rule: A target-less 'center' item gets centre spots. Bug found: 'center' fell into the against-wall branch, so every meeting table and required pod stood against a wall.
rules.evidence: 2026-10-16 office loop r2 critic (loop_office_r2.jpg): open 3-7, meeting 3-6, private 6-8, pantry 3-6; ITERATE; the meeting table was measured at x 3.72-4.84 in a 0-5 m room | validated 2026-10-16 office loop r3 (loop_office_r3.jpg): open 6-7, meeting 7-8, private 3-8, pantry 5-8: meeting room C3 4->7, C2 6->8

rules.rule: Open-office pods are not placed per planned relation. Identical pods go on a fixed-pitch grid parallel to the long wall: desks, a 0.85 m chair zone each side, 1 m aisles. This runs after the glass room and main aisle and before wall furniture.
rules.evidence: 2026-10-16 office loop r2 critic (loop_office_r2.jpg): open 3-7, meeting 3-6, private 6-8, pantry 3-6; ITERATE; pods planned 'corner'/'against_wall' failed; the open office scored 3 on workstations | validated 2026-10-16 office loop r3 (loop_office_r3.jpg): open 6-7, meeting 7-8, private 3-8, pantry 5-8: open office C1 3->7 (needed a 96-180 m2 floorplate and per-row DP packing)

rules.rule: Close a door by searching the leaf rotation that lays its mesh vertices (10-90 percentile) flat in the opening. Infinigen's rotation 0 stands Lite/Panel leaves 90 deg open.
rules.evidence: 2026-10-16 office loop r2 critic (loop_office_r2.jpg): open 3-7, meeting 3-6, private 6-8, pantry 3-6; ITERATE; every wide0 probe was blocked by an 'exterior_doors_closed: 1' leaf; on 47308102 the closed rotation is -90 deg | validated 2026-10-16 office loop r3 (loop_office_r3.jpg): open 6-7, meeting 7-8, private 3-8, pantry 5-8: no wide0 probe blocked by a door leaf in r3

rules.rule: Office task/conference chairs exclude sled, cantilever, visitor, stackable and leather executive models. Office casegoods exclude rustic, reclaimed and pallet wood. Pantry seating is bar stools at a 1.05 m table on a tile floor.
rules.evidence: 2026-10-16 office loop r2 critic (loop_office_r2.jpg): open 3-7, meeting 3-6, private 6-8, pantry 3-6; ITERATE; sled chairs in rows read as a waiting area; the pantry's cross-back chairs and carpet read as a dining room

rules.rule: Seats in a set (around a table, at pods, at desks) default to a natural pose: turned 8-35 deg either way and a third pulled back 5-30 cm, with the neat spot as fallback. Perfect rows look staged.
rules.evidence: user 2026-10-16 on r3: '의자 배치가 많이 일렬로 가지런해서 아쉽다 ... 회전을 좀 해있어야 자연스럽지'

rules.rule: Every work surface carries signs of use: mugs, paper, pen cups, notebooks with sticky notes, takeaway cups, half-eaten snacks, books and phones. Pods get 1.5-2.5 items per seat, desks 3-7, conference tables 4-8, break tables 2-4.
rules.evidence: user 2026-10-16 on r3: '사무실이 너무 깨끗해, 사람 손 타는 느낌이 없어 ... 먹다남은과자나 책이나 연필이나 컵'

rules.rule: A private office uses a procedural office desk (top, modesty panel, pedestal, monitor, keyboard), a task chair and 2 matching conference chairs as guest chairs. ABO pools for bookcase/filing exclude ladder shelves and nightstands.
rules.evidence: 2026-10-16 office loop r3 (loop_office_r3.jpg): open 6-7, meeting 7-8, private 3-8, pantry 5-8; private office C1 3, C6 3
